title: 🚛 The Late Shipment — GTLA 1
foot: 🚛 GTLA 1 · The Late Shipment — B1–B2 · self-marking 🚛
story: Nadia works as a transport coordinator for a logistics company in Dijon. This week, she has a problem: container TC-4519 has not arrived yet. The goods were loaded in Rotterdam last Wednesday, and the customer in Lyon has already called twice.

Yesterday, Nadia checked the tracking number: the container was blocked at customs for two days because a document was missing. The carrier apologized and sent a new ETA: Thursday, 8 a.m. Nadia called the customer: “I'm really sorry for the delay. The freight has just cleared customs, and the truck is on the highway now.”

This morning, the shipment finally arrived. Two boxes were damaged during the trip, so Nadia has opened a claim with the carrier's insurance. Rule number one in transport: every incident must be reported within 48 hours. She has already written the incident report — now she should call the customer with the good news. 🚛

sections.name: TR Traduction
sections.heading: Traduis : present perfect ou prétérit ?
sections.instr: Lis la phrase française et choisis la bonne traduction anglaise. Le repère de temps te dit quel temps utiliser.

items.text: « Le conteneur n'est pas encore arrivé. »
« Hier, le transporteur a envoyé une nouvelle ETA. »
options: Yesterday, the carrier sent a new ETA.
Yesterday, the carrier has sent a new ETA.
items.answer: Yesterday, the carrier sent a new ETA.

items.text: « Le client a appelé deux fois depuis lundi. »
options: The customer has called twice since Monday.
The customer called twice since Monday.
items.answer: The customer has called twice since Monday.

items.text: « Nous travaillons avec ce transporteur depuis 2020. »
options: We have worked with this carrier since 2020.
We worked with this carrier since 2020.
items.answer: We have worked with this carrier since 2020.

items.text: « Il y a trois jours, la marchandise a quitté Rotterdam. »
options: Three days ago, the freight left Rotterdam.
Three days ago, the freight has left Rotterdam.
items.answer: Three days ago, the freight left Rotterdam.

items.text: « As-tu déjà ouvert un dossier de litige ? »
options: Have you ever opened a claim?
Did you ever opened a claim?
items.answer: Have you ever opened a claim?

items.text: « La semaine dernière, deux cartons ont été endommagés. »
options: Last week, two boxes were damaged.
Last week, two boxes have been damaged.
items.answer: Last week, two boxes were damaged.

items.text: « Nous n'avons pas encore reçu les documents. »
options: We haven't received the documents yet.
We didn't receive the documents yet.
items.answer: We haven't received the documents yet.
